results.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press (45 Degree View)
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Start with your arms bent, palms facing your shoulders, and elbows close to your torso.
Press your back against the bench. Begin to press the dumbbells overhead. As you press, rotate your palms so they face forward at the top of the movement.
Fully extend your arms at the top, ensuring your biceps are near your ears.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position by rotating your palms back towards your shoulders. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Rotate your wrists smoothly during the pressing and lowering phases to avoid strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press the weights up and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Keep your feet firmly planted to provide a stable base of support.
Focus on the full range of motion to engage all parts of the shoulder muscles effectively.
results.description: Dumbbell Arnold Press (45 Degree View) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Chest, Triceps.

results.name: Backhand Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent and lean forward at the hips until your torso is halfway parallel to the floor. Keep your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back parallel to your torso with your palms facing backwards.
Raise your arms upwards, keeping them straight, until they are over your back.
Lower your arms back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and support your lower back throughout the exercise.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to enhance upper back activation.
results.description: Backhand Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Back.

results.name: Band Horizontal Shrug
instructions: Attach one end of a loop resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at head height. Stand facing the band with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the other end of the band with your arms extended straight forward.
Pull your shoulders backward in a horizontal shrugging motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the tension in the band, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions
tips: Focus on using your upper back and shoulders for the shrugging motion, avoiding any arm bending.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you shrug and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Use a controlled motion to ensure proper form and maximize muscle activation.
results.description: Band Horizontal Shrug is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Band Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place one end of the resistance band securely under your foot of the working side. Hold the other end of the band in your working hand at shoulder height, palm facing inward.
Press the band overhead by fully extending your arm, keeping your wrist straight and elbow slightly bent at the top.
Slowly lower the band back to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Use a controlled motion to press and lower the band to maximize muscle activation.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you press the band up and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Ensure the band is securely anchored under your foot to prevent slipping.
results.description: Band Single Arm Overhead Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back, Core.

results.name: Barbell Back Wide Shrug
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with both hands behind your back. Your palms should face away from your body with a wide grip.
Keep your shoulders back and chest up. Slowly lift your shoulders towards your ears in a shrugging motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement, holding the contraction for a moment.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid rotating your shoulders; lift them straight up and down to prevent strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your shoulders and inhaling as you lower them.
Keep your arms straight throughout the exercise to focus the movement on your shoulders.
results.description: Barbell Back Wide Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Barbell Behind Neck Push Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with both hands behind your neck. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with the barbell resting on your upper back and shoulders.
Slightly bend your knees, preparing to use your legs to generate power.

Push through your heels and extend your knees and hips explosively, pressing the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended. Keep the bar slightly behind your head at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position behind your neck with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid excessive backward lean by engaging your core and keeping your chest up.
Exhale forcefully as you press the barbell overhead and inhale as you bring it back down.
Ensure a smooth and controlled descent to maintain proper form and prevent injury.
results.description: Barbell Behind Neck Push Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Triceps.

results.name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs. Your hands should be shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell in front of you with straight arms until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, keeping your arms straight. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your elbows to reduce strain on the joints.
Lift with your shoulders rather than swinging your body to ensure proper muscle engagement.
Keep your core tight to support your lower back and maintain proper posture.
results.description: Barbell Front Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Overhead Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell overhead with both hands, using a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width. Keep your arms fully extended and your core engaged.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears in a shrugging motion while keeping your arms extended and the barbell stable overhead.
Hold the shrugged position briefly, squeezing your trapezius muscles.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended and your shoulders engaged to maintain control of the barbell.
Focus on the upward shrugging motion to maximize trapezius activation.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Overhead Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell behind your glutes with an overhand grip (palms facing back), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Engage your rear deltoids and lift the barbell upward behind your back by raising your elbows.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Barbell Rear Delt Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Seated Behind Neck Military Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing forward), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Position the barbell behind your neck at shoulder height.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your elbows until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position behind your neck with control, bending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your head and neck neutral to prevent overextension or strain.
Focus on a controlled motion to engage your shoulder muscles effectively.
Ensure your grip is secure to maintain stability throughout the exercise.
results.description: Barbell Seated Behind Neck Military Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Back.
